name: Venezuela
shortSummary: India has maintained pragmatic energy-focused ties with Venezuela, importing crude oil intermittently as US sanctions policy has shifted, while the country's political and economic crisis has limited broader engagement.

majorAreasOfCooperation.description: India has periodically imported Venezuelan crude oil depending on the prevailing US sanctions regime.

majorChallenges.title: US sanctions exposure
majorChallenges.description: Venezuela's sanctions status has repeatedly disrupted the energy trade relationship.

sources.title: Bilateral brief
sources.publisher: Ministry of External Affairs, Government of India
